<!--
Category: Announcements
Title:    📖 Guide: Use Rolebranch inside ChatGPT, Claude or Le Chat
-->

Connect your AI app once, and its chats work from your master CVs and applications: ask whether a
posting is worth applying to, which applications need a follow-up this week, or have Romy tailor a
CV, without leaving the chat.

## Where to start

In Rolebranch, open **Connectors** at the foot of the sidebar (on a phone, from your initials at the
top right), or press **G** then **C**. Pick your app and choose **Connect**: its page walks you
through each step. Rolebranch's address is:

```
https://app.rolebranch.com/mcp
```

## ChatGPT

1. In ChatGPT, open **Settings › Security and login** and turn on **Developer mode** (it depends on your plan and, at work, your workspace).
2. Open **Settings › Plugins**, choose **+**, enter the name **Rolebranch** and the address, keep **OAuth**, and choose **Create**.
3. Sign in to Rolebranch if asked, choose what ChatGPT may do and its monthly credits, then **Allow**.
4. In a chat, turn on **Rolebranch** from **+**.

## Claude

1. In Claude, open **Customize › Connectors**, choose **+ › Add custom connector**, enter **Rolebranch** and the address, and choose **Add**.
2. Choose **Rolebranch**, then **Connect**. Sign in if asked, choose what Claude may do and its credits, then **Allow**.
3. In a chat, turn it on from **+ › Connectors**. It then works in the Claude phone app too.

Le Chat, Raycast and any app that takes a remote MCP address have their own steps on the
Connectors page.

## What it can and can't do

✅ Read your master CVs and applications (never your contact details), add and update applications,
read a posting you share, brief you on what's next, and ask Romy for CVs, letters and interview prep
**with your credits, up to the limit you set** (100 a month unless you change it, 0 to turn it off).

❌ It can't apply or write to employers, delete anything, change your master CVs, or accept Romy's
drafts for you. Her drafts always wait for your review in Rolebranch.

Change its limit, see what it did, or **Disconnect** it any time from **Connectors**.
[Full guide →](https://rolebranch.com/help/account/connect-chatgpt-claude-cursor)

Which other AI apps should we support? Tell us in
[💡 Ideas](https://github.com/orgs/Rolebranch/discussions/new?category=ideas).
